turns.content: Count ordered five-card poker deals from a 52-card deck while also claiming that reorderings of the same cards are the same outcome. Choose a counting framework.
Write the applicable count in compact combinatorial notation.
Expand and simplify that expression in factorial form.
Evaluate the number of ordered five-card deal sequences and retain it as the poker-hand total.
Give an independent consistency check without merely repeating the calculation.
Report the total and its sample-space interpretation.
